title: How PayJoin Works
summary: The first Privacy Track: why Bitcoin needs privacy, how PayJoin fools chain analysis, and a real PayJoin sent live on the call.
share_text: How PayJoin works: notes + every resource from the first @CodeOrangeDevs Privacy Track
tldr: Privacy keeps Bitcoin free, censorship-resistant and fungible. Without private payments it can be captured like gold.
PayJoin mixes coins from the sender and the receiver in one transaction that looks completely normal.
That breaks two chain-analysis guesses: all inputs belong to one person, and the big leftover is the change.
PayJoin v2 needs no server of your own: a mailbox and a relay pass messages, and neither sees the whole picture.
